Title: Verify search query for sold out item displays Sold Out badge in results and disables purchase button on product page
Preconditions: User has network access to storefront
Steps:
1. Navigate to /search?q=Brown+Shades
2. Verify search result item displays 'Brown Shades' with £20.00 price and explicit 'SOLD OUT' overlay badge
3. Click on 'Brown Shades' search result link
4. Verify product detail page loads with heading 'Brown Shades' and price £20.00
5. Inspect purchase button and verify value is 'Sold Out' and element is strictly disabled
Expected Result: Search results display Brown Shades with SOLD OUT badge, and product page displays disabled 'Sold Out' purchase button
Test Data: Query: Brown Shades | Expected Badge: SOLD OUT | PDP Button: value='Sold Out' disabled=true

Title: Verify cart guard prevents adding sold out item and direct checkout navigation preserves empty cart state
Preconditions: User is on product page of sold out item with empty cart session
Steps:
1. Navigate to /products/brown-shades
2. Verify purchase button is disabled and cannot be submitted
3. Check header cart counter remains at 'My Cart (0)'
4. Navigate directly to /cart
5. Verify empty cart message 'It appears that your cart is currently empty!' and checkout action is unavailable
Expected Result: Cart counter remains 0, /cart displays empty state message, and checkout cannot proceed
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/products/brown-shades | Cart URL: /cart | Expected Counter: My Cart (0)

Title: Verify search query for secondary out-of-stock item White sandals correctly displays Sold Out badge alongside in-stock items
Preconditions: User has network access to storefront search
Steps:
1. Navigate to /search?q=White+sandals
2. Verify search results list multiple items
3. Verify in-stock item 'Bronze sandals' displays without Sold Out badge
4. Verify out-of-stock item 'White sandals' displays with explicit 'SOLD OUT' overlay badge
5. Click 'White sandals' and verify purchase button is disabled with 'Sold Out'
Expected Result: Search results properly distinguish between available and depleted stock with accurate Sold Out badge on White sandals
Test Data: Query: White sandals | Mixed Results: Bronze sandals (In Stock), White sandals (SOLD OUT)

Title: Verify sold out item status consistency across search refresh and header search submission
Steps:
1. Navigate to store homepage https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/
2. Enter 'Brown Shades' in header search field and submit form
3. Verify URL updates to /search?*q=Brown+Shades
4. Verify 'Brown Shades' product card displays SOLD OUT badge
5. Reload search results page and verify SOLD OUT status persists with zero cart increment
Expected Result: Header search submission successfully routes to search page with persistent SOLD OUT badge and 0 cart count
Test Data: Storefront: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/ | Search Input: Brown Shades | Expected: /search URL with Sold Out badge
